summary: CONTEXT: most project failures are requirements bugs. SkillSwap sentence 'Users can book time slots and pay through the platform' hides user identity, slot timezone, double-book lock, hold-vs-capture, commission, city/FX, payment-fail release, confirm policy, idempotency, and cancellation.
evidence: Story: four engineers, six weeks, spec 'cancel bookings'; support exploded on 5-minute full refunds; rebuild of capture vs hold, slot release, emails. Cancel button was three days; wrong payment model was the rest.
Four hidden cancel questions: when, financial consequence, who owns policy, slot after cancel.
Own assumption list (10) plus hint list (duration, hold vs pay, race, methods, guest, provider confirm).
Tied to SkillSwap constraints already recorded: no double-booking, commission consistency, multi-city, testable cancellation.
